Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 6

“But renunciation is hard to attain without yoga, mighty-armed one. The sage disciplined in yoga reaches Brahman before long.”

The practical reason behind his ranking. Renunciation attempted without the groundwork of disciplined action is described as simply painful — Krishna is heading off a shortcut.
